706:t_1:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「...So what exactly is this $$カオス・コスモス$$, anyway?」

706:t_1:5.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Apparently it's some kind of parallel world, but even when we send out open comms in every direction, nobody replies.」

706:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Won't the $$御使い$$s find us if we do that?」

706:t_1:7.en:
$$青山$$
「Ever since we came into this universe, we've practically been under their watch anyway. It's a little late to worry about that now.」

706:t_1:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wherever we go, those guys are watching us...」

706:t_1:9.en:
$n
(Ever since we came to this universe, I've felt this constant pressure... It's driving us into a corner...)

706:t_1:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「$c is making use of this universe's properties to repeat long-distance jumps while tracing the will of the $$御使い$$s.」

706:t_1:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we keep going like this, we'll run into them somewhere along the way.」

706:t_1:12.en:
$$赤木$$
「Still, it's creepy that nobody is answering us.」

706:t_1:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「Maybe this universe... has nobody left alive anymore...」

706:t_1:15.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「...It's true. I can't sense any breath of life in this world...」

706:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Those bastards...! So they wiped out everything that got in the way of the universe they live in...!」

706:t_1:17.en:
$n
「And a world they remade just as they wished... That's this $$カオス・コスモス$$, then...」

706:t_1:18.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But it's certain that we and the $$御使い$$s aren't the only ones in this universe.」

706:t_1:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$... And $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, then.」

706:t_1:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So in the end, there's nothing here but enemies...」

706:t_1:23.en:
$$タケル$$
「I just remembered that when $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ appeared before, they said they needed preparations to fight us.」

706:t_1:24.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I remember it too. But since then, even though the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and the others have shown themselves, they never fought us.」

706:t_1:26.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Do you have some idea, $$グーラ$$?」

706:t_1:27.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「If something is bothering you, tell us. Right now we want even the smallest scrap of information.」

706:t_1:28.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...It seems to me that both Father and $$皇帝ズール$$ had the defeat of the $$御使い$$s as their ultimate goal.」

706:t_1:29.en:
$$赤木$$
「Even when the Galactic Raid Fleet set out, it felt like that.」

706:t_1:30.en:
$$青山$$
「So even trying to take Earth was, in the end, for the sake of fighting the $$御使い$$s?」

706:t_1:31.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Could the preparations Father and the others spoke of be the invasion of this $$カオス・コスモス$$...?」

706:t_1:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「In other words, their real goal was to make us annihilate the $$バアル$$ and lay the $$天柱$$ bare...」

706:t_1:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「They were trying to use our power to get here?」

706:t_1:35.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The army of darkness has most likely invaded this $$カオス・コスモス$$ as well.」

706:t_1:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The $$御使い$$s, $$アサキム$$, $$ヴィルダーク$$... Or else...」

706:t_1:38.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whichever it is, they're still enemies!」

706:t_1:40.en:
$n
(If we keep fighting battles like this... can we really win...?)

707:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...So this is the center of the galaxy, long shrouded in mystery.」

707:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It is just empty space, with absolutely nothing in it.」

707:t_000:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The Great Attractor that existed here vanished into the gap between dimensions because of the $$時空震動弾$$ from $c.」

707:t_000:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「It is not the only thing that vanished. $c itself did, too.」

707:t_000:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They are the people we are talking about, after all. I am sure they are alive and well.」

707:t_000:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Yes... They must be heading to where the rulers of the $$サイデリアル$$ are.」

707:t_000:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... Is he challenging God, carrying the feelings Lady $$エルーナ$$ and the others entrusted to him...?」

707:t_000:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ is already half collapsed, so it is a little odd to call him 'His Majesty' anymore, though.」

707:t_000:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But even if the $$サイデリアル$$ is destroyed, the pride of the $$ハイアデス$$ will not fade...!」

707:t_000:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Those of us who happened to survive should clear out the remaining $$バアル$$ and put our effort into the cleanup.」

707:t_000:12.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Soon, talks will begin between the Earth side, the representatives of each organization that took part in the operation, and various other races as well.」

707:t_000:13.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Earth, which defeated the $$サイデリアル$$ and stopped the $$バアル$$ invasion, will probably be the one to lead this galaxy from now on...」

707:t_000:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The people of that planet kept hold of the indomitable fighting spirit and hope that were being lost from the galaxy... That must have become a great power that defeated the $$バアル$$.」

707:t_000:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And so the future was protected. From here, a new era begins again.」

707:t_000:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Not that it matters, unless the merciless emissary of God even allows humanity to exist.)

707:t_000:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Thinking of it that way, even if the $$バアル$$ are destroyed, this universe's future of despair won't change...)

707:t_000:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(How much longer will we... be allowed to live, I wonder...)

712:t_1:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
(Forgive me, $$ドゥリタラー$$, $$ウィルパーシャ$$... And you, too, $$ヴァイシュラバ$$...)

712:t_1:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
(I was unable to fulfill my duty as a $$次元将$$... Even if I meet you, all I can do is apologize...)

712:t_1:7.en:
???
「This is the place where the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist meet...」

712:t_1:8.en:
???
「You still have something you must do...」

712:t_1:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It seems you have gone and done something unnecessary again.」

712:t_1:15.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do you not intend to reconsider?」

712:t_1:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Now that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ has come back at long last, let's have fun again, the four of us!」

712:t_1:18.en:
???
「I have never once thought any of it was fun.」

712:t_1:19.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do you intend to abandon the mission of the higher-dimensional life forms?」

712:t_1:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「What you did amounts to rebellion against our very existence.」

712:t_1:22.en:
???
「I did it fully prepared for that.」

712:t_1:23.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well, $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$. Then spend eternity within this dimensional prison.」

712:t_1:24.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Regrettable as it is, I will also place a barrier around you. Now you have no freedom left.」

712:t_1:25.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is our punishment to you.」
